question: List partially covered Gram Panchayats in papum pare for Multi-purpose

question: Show me coverage details for all blocks in belagavi for Multi-purpose
expected_sql: SELECT sub.block_name, sub.total_villages, sub.covered_villages, ROUND((sub.covered_villages::numeric / sub.total_villages) * 100, 2) AS block_coverage_percent FROM (SELECT dbgv.block_name, COUNT(DISTINCT dbgv.village_code) AS total_villages, COUNT(DISTINCT cr.village_code) AS covered_villages FROM public.chatbot_districts_blocks_gp_villages dbgv LEFT JOIN public.chatbot_coverage_areas cr ON cr.state_code = dbgv.state_code AND cr.district_code = dbgv.district_code AND cr.block_code = dbgv.block_code AND cr.village_code = dbgv.village_code AND cr.status = 1 AND cr.is_approved != 2 AND cr.is_draft = 0 AND cr.sector_of_operation_name ILIKE '%multi%' WHERE dbgv.state_name ILIKE '%KARNATAKA%' AND dbgv.district_name ILIKE '%BELAGAVI%' AND dbgv.status = 1 GROUP BY dbgv.block_name, dbgv.block_code) AS sub ORDER BY sub.block_name;
generated_sql:
SELECT block_name, COUNT(DISTINCT village_name) AS total_villages, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN federation_doing_business = 'Yes' THEN village_name END) AS covered_villages, ROUND((COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN federation_doing_business = 'Yes' THEN village_name END)::numeric / COUNT(DISTINCT village_name)) * 100, 2) AS block_coverage_percent 
FROM chatbot_state_district_federation_private 
WHERE state_name ILIKE '%BELAGAVI%' AND primary_activity_name ILIKE '%Multi-purpose%' 
GROUP BY block_name
ORDER BY block_name;

question: How many full covered GPs are there in madurai for Fishery?
expected_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS covered_gp_count FROM (SELECT dbgv.gram_panchayat_name FROM public.chatbot_districts_blocks_gp_villages dbgv LEFT JOIN public.chatbot_coverage_areas cr ON cr.state_code = dbgv.state_code AND cr.district_code = dbgv.district_code AND cr.panchayat_code = dbgv.gram_panchayat_code AND cr.village_code = dbgv.village_code AND cr.status = 1 AND cr.is_approved != 2 AND cr.is_draft = 0 AND cr.sector_of_operation_name ILIKE '%fishery%' WHERE dbgv.state_name ILIKE '%TAMIL NADU%' AND dbgv.district_name ILIKE '%MADURAI%' AND dbgv.status = 1 GROUP BY dbgv.gram_panchayat_name, dbgv.gram_panchayat_code HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT cr.village_code) > 0 AND COUNT(DISTINCT cr.village_code) = COUNT(DISTINCT dbgv.village_code)) AS sub;
generated_sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS covered_gp_count 
FROM (
    SELECT cdg.gram_panchayat_name 
    FROM chatbot_state_district_federation_private cdg 
    LEFT JOIN chatbot_coverage_areas cr ON cr.state_code = cdg.state_code 
        AND cr.district_code = cdg.district_code 
        AND cr.panchayat_code = cdg.gram_panchayat_code 
        AND cr.status = 1 
        AND cr.is_approved != 2 
        AND cr.is_draft = 0 
        AND cr.sector_of_operation_name ILIKE '%fishery%' 
    WHERE cdg.state_name ILIKE '%TAMIL NADU%' 
        AND cdg.district_name ILIKE '%MADURAI%' 
        AND cdg.status = 1 
    GROUP BY cdg.gram_panchayat_name, cdg.gram_panchayat_code 
    HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT cr.village_code) > 0 
        AND COUNT(DISTINCT cr.village_code) = COUNT(DISTINCT cdg.village_code)
) AS sub;
